facts.text: Under the state-legislated NC Promise Tuition Plan, undergraduate in-state tuition at UNC Pembroke is set at $500 per semester, with out-of-state tuition set at $2,500 to $3,500 per semester.

sources.title: NC Promise – UNC System
sources.quote: Through NC Promise, the state has significantly reduced tuition cost for in-state students to $500 per semester at four UNC System institutions: Elizabeth City State University, Fayetteville State University, University of North Carolina Pembroke, and Western Carolina University.
